products.name: Gemini app
products.tag: Everyday AI assistant — on its own or built into Google Workspace
products.best: Everyday work: chat, writing, research, and Gemini inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets & Meet

highlights.title: Gemini 4 Argon
highlights.text: Google's newest flagship model, on AI Pro and Ultra (Oct 13, 2026).

highlights.title: Deep Research
highlights.text: Cited research reports from the web — and from your Gmail, Drive and Chat on Workspace.

highlights.title: Inside Workspace
highlights.text: Side panel in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive and Chat; edit whole Slides decks; Fill with Gemini in Sheets now cites cells.

highlights.title: Meet
highlights.text: Take notes for me, meeting recaps in Chat, and real-time speech translation in 63 languages.

highlights.title: Skills (replacing Gems)
highlights.text: Reusable instructions and workflows, rolling out Oct–Nov 2026.

highlights.title: Tasks & coding
highlights.text: Tasks mode for longer jobs and Antigravity coding in the macOS app (AI Pro/Ultra).

highlights.title: Gemini Notebook built in
highlights.text: Use @Gemini Notebook to query or create notebooks from chat.

plans.name: Free

plans.name: Google AI Plus — $4.99/mo
plans.detail: 2× limits, Omni Flash video, Gemini in Gmail.

plans.name: Google AI Pro — $19.99/mo
plans.detail: Gemini 4 Argon, 4× limits, 5 TB, entry Antigravity access.

plans.name: Google AI Ultra — $99.99 or $199.99/mo

plans.name: Workspace

products.data: Workspace: your data isn't used for training or reviewed by humans, and existing access permissions apply. Personal accounts: chats may be used to improve Google AI unless you turn off Gemini Apps Activity.
products.watch: On Workspace, Gemini 4 Argon access and limits depend on your edition and add-ons. Gems stop working on Business/Enterprise accounts no earlier than March 1, 2027 — move them to Skills.

products.name: Gemini Notebook
products.tag: Research assistant that only answers from the sources you give it
products.best: Making sense of a stack of documents — with citations, podcasts and study guides

highlights.title: Answers from your sources
highlights.text: Every answer cites the documents you uploaded; it won't make things up from the web.

highlights.title: Studio outputs
highlights.text: Audio & Video Overviews (incl. 60-second shorts), slide decks, reports, quizzes, flashcards, mind maps and infographics.

highlights.title: Creative control
highlights.text: Review the outline or producer notes before a slide deck or video is generated (Oct 2026).

highlights.title: Code Execution
highlights.text: Each notebook gets a secure cloud computer for data analysis (AI Ultra; rolling out to Pro).

highlights.title: Deep Research
highlights.text: Finds web sources for you and adds them to the notebook.

highlights.title: Everywhere
highlights.text: Notebooks in the Gemini app and in AI Mode in Search (personal accounts, English, rolling out since Aug 2026).

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: 100 notebooks, 50 sources each.

plans.name: Google AI Plus
plans.detail: 200 notebooks × 100 sources, 2× usage.

plans.name: Google AI Pro
plans.detail: 500 notebooks × 300 sources, 4× usage.

plans.name: Google AI Ultra
plans.detail: 500 notebooks × 500–600 sources, highest usage.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Gemini Notebook Enterprise via Google Cloud / Gemini Enterprise, with an Enterprise API (v1alpha).

products.data: Your sources, questions and outputs aren't used to train models — on personal and enterprise accounts.
products.watch: Since Sept 2, 2026 usage is compute-based: it refreshes every 5 hours up to a weekly cap, replacing the old fixed daily counts. There's no consumer API.
recent: Oct 23 — Connected app inside Gemini (@Gemini Notebook)
Oct 16 — Review outlines for slide decks & Video Overviews
Aug 19 — Notebooks in AI Mode in Search

products.name: AI Studio
products.tag: Free developer playground and home of the Gemini API
products.best: Developers trying Gemini models, prototyping AI apps, and getting an API key

highlights.title: Playground
highlights.text: Try every Gemini model in the browser, then export the code.

highlights.title: API keys in seconds
highlights.text: Self-serve keys with no Google Cloud setup; new gemini-api CLI (beta).

highlights.title: Build mode
highlights.text: Prompt to a full-stack web app (React + Node) or native Android app; deploy to Cloud Run, sync to GitHub, set up Firebase.

highlights.title: Latest models
highlights.text: Gemini 4 Argon, 3.8 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite; Nano Banana 2.1 (images), Lyria 3.5 (music), Gemini Omni Flash (video).

highlights.title: Agent tools
highlights.text: Computer Use (GA Oct 30), MCP support in the SDK and Interactions API, Deep Research agent.

plans.name: AI Studio
plans.detail: Free.

plans.name: Gemini API free tier
plans.detail: No billing needed; rate-limited; no Gemini 4 Argon or media models.

plans.name: Paid tier
plans.detail: Pay per token. Gemini 4 Argon: $2 / $10 per 1M tokens (in/out) until Nov 30, then $4 / $20. Flex (~½ price) and Priority tiers.

products.data: Free tier: prompts and outputs may be used to improve Google products, including human review. Paid tier: not used for training.
products.watch: New paid projects store requests by default since Oct 26, 2026. Veo 3.1 previews were shut down in the Gemini API on Oct 22 — use Gemini Omni Flash, or Veo on Agent Platform. Need IAM, regions or VPC-SC? Move to Agent Platform.
recent: Oct 22 — Veo 3.1 previews retired → Omni Flash

products.name: Antigravity
products.former: Replaces Gemini CLI, Gemini Code Assist and Jules
products.best: Developers handing coding work to AI agents — or coding side-by-side with one

highlights.title: Desktop app
highlights.text: Mission control for parallel agents: Automations (scheduled runs), subagents, reviewable plans and walkthroughs, browser testing, Remote Control from any browser.

highlights.title: CLI (agy)
highlights.text: Terminal agent and Gemini CLI's successor; headless mode for CI (agy -p, JSON output).

highlights.title: IDE extensions
highlights.text: VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, Zed and Xcode — on every plan, including free (Aug 2026).

highlights.title: Plugin Marketplace
highlights.text: One install bundles skills, MCP servers, hooks and custom agents — Vercel, Notion, Linear, Sentry, Supabase and more (Oct 29).

highlights.title: Models
highlights.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash on every plan; Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Sonnet/Opus 5.5 on paid plans.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: $0 with a Google account; weekly quota.

plans.name: Google AI Pro — $19.99/mo
plans.detail: Quota refreshes every 5 hours up to a weekly cap.

plans.name: Google AI Ultra — $99.99 or $199.99/mo
plans.detail: Highest caps; buy AI credits for overage.

plans.name: Business
plans.detail: Through Google Cloud: Gemini Enterprise Standard/Plus seats (from $30/seat/mo, with pooled credits) or pay-as-you-go.

products.data: Free/Pro/Ultra: interaction data is collected to improve products unless you opt out. Business (Google Cloud): not used to train models.
products.watch: Business plans cover the desktop app, CLI and IDE extensions — not the older standalone IDE. Gemini models and Claude/GPT models have separate quotas.
recent: Oct 15 — Pick a model per Automation
Aug 20 — IDE extensions + Antigravity in Gemini Enterprise

products.name: Gemini Enterprise
products.tag: The company-wide AI hub on Google Cloud
products.best: Whole organizations: AI search across every work app, plus no-code agents with IT control

highlights.title: Search across work apps
highlights.text: Permission-aware answers over Google Workspace, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, Slack, Teams, Notion and more.

highlights.title: Workflow Builder
highlights.text: No-code agents that run on a schedule, on demand or by @-mention; import ADK/A2A agents (GA Sep 3, 2026).

highlights.title: Agent Gallery
highlights.text: Google-built and partner agents, approved by IT.

highlights.title: Built in
highlights.text: Deep Research, Gemini Notebook Enterprise, image & video generation in every edition.

highlights.title: Models
highlights.text: Gemini 4 Argon by default (Oct 27); Claude Opus/Sonnet 5.5 pay-as-you-go.

highlights.title: Coming
highlights.text: The Gemini agent: long-running tasks with its own sub-agents (private preview, announced Oct 8).

plans.name: Business — $21/user/mo
plans.detail: Annual; for 1–500 users.

plans.name: Standard / Plus
plans.detail: Per seat, larger orgs and extra controls; include Antigravity credits.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.detail: No seat fee, usage-billed (GA Aug 1, 2026).

plans.name: Frontline
plans.detail: For 150+ frontline workers.

plans.name: Trial
plans.detail: 30 days.

products.data: Covered by Google Cloud data terms — not used for training. VPC-SC, CMEK and granular IAM per app and data store.
products.watch: New or renewed Standard/Plus subscriptions no longer include Gemini Code Assist (Sept 17, 2026) — use Antigravity instead. Google's product page now also calls it “Gemini for Business”.
recent: Oct 27 — Gemini 4 Argon is the default model

products.best: Engineering teams building production AI apps and agents on Google Cloud

highlights.title: Models

highlights.title: Ship to users

highlights.title: Production extras

products.data: Google Cloud data terms — not used for training; your data stays in your project and chosen region.

timeline.text: Computer Use tool goes GA in the Gemini API.
Antigravity Plugin Marketplace — skills, MCP servers and agents in one install. Jules shutdown announced.
Gemini 4 Argon launches across the Gemini API, Gemini app (AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity and Gemini Enterprise.
Gemini Code Assist stops taking new subscriptions; Google points customers to Antigravity.
Gemini agent for business announced — long-running tasks with sub-agents (private preview).
Skills begin replacing Gems in Workspace and the Gemini app.
Workflow Builder (formerly Agent Designer) goes GA in Gemini Enterprise.
Gemini 3.8 Flash GA. Gemini Notebook switches to compute-based usage limits.
Antigravity IDE extensions for VS Code, JetBrains, Zed, Xcode and Visual Studio; Antigravity comes to Gemini Enterprise.
Notebooks from Gemini Notebook start appearing in AI Mode in Search.
Gemini Enterprise adds a pay-as-you-go edition.
